Windows 3.11 desktop would typically be in graphics mode (640x480). We need to wait for the VM to continue booting and take another screenshot to check progress.",
  "plan": "Wait about 15 seconds for the VM to continue booting, then take another screenshot and check the resolution. If it's still in text mode, the VM may be at a DOS prompt and we may need to send a `win` command via the monitor.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "sleep 15
python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import socket, time
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect('/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock')
time.sleep(0.3)
s.recv(4096)
s.sendall(b'screendump /tmp/qemu-screen2.ppm\n')
time.sleep(0.5)
print(s.recv(4096).decode(errors='replace'))
s.close()
PYEOF
ls -la /tmp/qemu-screen2.ppm 2>/dev/null && python3 -c "
with open('/tmp/qemu-screen2.ppm','rb') as f:
    header = f.readline().strip()
    dims = f.readline().strip()
    maxval = f.readline().strip()
    print('Format:', header.decode())
    print('Dimensions:', dims.decode())
    print('Max value:', maxval.decode())
"

      "duration": 20.0
    }
